neighbours.label: formal denial of warrant or implication: 'any' / 'for' right after 'does not imply/create/constitute' or 'no grounds/warrant/basis' (not informal 'didn't have any')
fire: Inclusion in this directory does not constitute any recommendation of the listed firms.
The evidence offers no basis for overturning the earlier verdict.
Nothing in this agreement confers any right on a third party.
The committee saw no justification for extending the deadline again.
The use of trade names does not imply any approval by the agency.
There is no warrant for reading the clause so broadly.
These are not scientific theories in any strict sense.
The audit revealed no grounds for doubting the published figures.
quiet: Inclusion in this directory is open to any firm listed in the region.
The evidence offers a basis for the earlier verdict.
This agreement confers some rights on a third party.
The committee thanked her for extending the deadline again.
The use of trade names implies approval by the agency.
There is a warrant out for the man who broke the window.
These are scientific theories in the strict sense.
The audit covered the published figures for the whole year.

notes: Card: ' any' x9, ' for' x5 after negated predicates in formal prose. Probes: 'creates any obligation' 0.49, 'no grounds for changing' 0.64, 'does not imply any' 0.23; affirmative any/for ~0.02; colloquial 'didn't have any money' 0.00, 'no need for alarm' 0.05. Low max (5.4), so margins are thin.
